source_construct: PROC LOGISTIC nofit + roc 'Logistic Model' pred=pd_logistic + roccontrast; ods output ROCAssociation=work.roc_stats
target_translation: sas_compat.roc_association(y=default_flag, score=pd_logistic, label='Logistic Model') -> ONE row, columns in this order: ROCModel (the ROC statement label), Area, StdErr, LowerArea, UpperArea, SomersD, Gamma, TauA (no 'Model' row: nofit fits nothing). With n1 events (default_flag=1, event='1'), n0 nonevents, P=n1*n0 pairs, N=n1+n0: an event/nonevent pair is concordant when pd_event > pd_nonevent, TIED when |pd_event - pd_nonevent| <= 1e-8 (same fuzz as RULEBOOK A8; exact equality prints identically on every input), else discordant; Area = (C + T/2)/P (Mann-Whitney); StdErr = DeLong: V10_i = (#nonevents below event i + 0.5*#tied)/n0, V01_j = (#events above nonevent j + 0.5*#tied)/n1, StdErr = sqrt(var(V10, ddof=1)/n1 + var(V01, ddof=1)/n0); LowerArea/UpperArea = Area -/+ 1.959963985*StdErr (95% Wald); SomersD = (C-D)/P; Gamma = (C-D)/(C+D); TauA = (C-D)/(N(N-1)/2). O(N log N) via searchsorted on the sorted nonevent/event scores, never an N1 x N0 matrix. Keep full precision in memory (downstream uses Area). Printed (proc export of the ODS dataset, formatted values): Area, LowerArea, UpperArea, SomersD, Gamma, TauA with 4 decimals ('0.8592'); StdErr with SAS's D8. format, the SAME emulation as the modelstat-fit row for model_coefficients.csv Estimate/StdErr (decimals = max(4, decimals needed for 3 significant digits): '0.00234', '0.00357', '0.0170', '0.0159', '0.0149', all 6 observed cells; NEVER 8.4, which prints '0.0023'). TauA prints 4 decimals on every input (0.0298..0.0895); 8.4 and D8. differ only below 0.01, unreachable. Rows with missing default_flag or pd_logistic would be dropped by PROC LOGISTIC; none exist on any input (pd never missing in train/metrics, batch-1 rows 5 and 16); ties are LOAD-BEARING on the edge scenarios (half-credit in Area, Gamma != SomersD). `roccontrast` with a single ROC curve prints and outputs nothing (listing) and changes no ROCAssociation value: not ported. work.roc_stats (full precision) feeds auc_summary AUC / Gini = 2*Area - 1 (:57-64), never the printed 4-decimal text.

target_translation: inside confusion_metrics(): cm = conf_matrix (group_by(['default_flag', 'predicted'], maintain_order=True).len() renamed COUNT); TP, TN, FP, FN = COUNT of cells (1,1), (0,0), (0,1), (1,0), 0 when the cell is absent (retain initial value; a cell is absent when no row is predicted 1 at that threshold).
